edits.text: PRELIMINARY STATEMENT. Defendant responds to Plaintiff’s First Requests for Production subject to the objections set forth below.
1. GENERAL OBJECTIONS. Defendant objects to each request to the extent it seeks privileged, protected, or otherwise non-discoverable material.
2. PRODUCTION. Subject to and without waiving these objections, Defendant will produce responsive, non-privileged documents in its possession, custody, or control.
3. PRIVILEGE LOG. Documents withheld on privilege or protection grounds, if any, will be identified on a privilege log in accordance with the applicable rules.
4. RESERVATION. Defendant reserves the right to supplement or amend this response as appropriate.

edits.text: Defendant’s Responses and Objections to Plaintiff’s First Requests for Production of Documents
edits.name: title

edits.text: PRELIMINARY STATEMENT. Defendant responds to Plaintiff’s First Requests for Production subject to the specific objections stated below and to the extent any responsive materials exist in Defendant’s possession, custody, or control.
edits.name: prelim

edits.text: 1. GENERAL OBJECTIONS. Defendant objects to each request to the extent it seeks information or documents protected by the attorney-client privilege, work-product doctrine, or any other applicable privilege or protection; seeks information not relevant to any party’s claims or defenses; is overly broad, unduly burdensome, or vague; or seeks materials not proportional to the needs of the case. Defendant further objects to any request to the extent it calls for documents already equally available to Plaintiff or not within Defendant’s possession, custody, or control.
edits.name: general objections

edits.text: 2. REQUEST-BY-REQUEST RESPONSES. Subject to the foregoing objections, Defendant will produce non-privileged responsive documents, if any, on a rolling basis beginning on or before [DATE] and continuing as they are collected and reviewed. To the extent any responsive documents are withheld, they are withheld only on the basis of the specific objections stated in response to the particular request and/or privilege or protection. Any documents withheld on privilege or protection grounds, if any, will be identified on a privilege log served in accordance with the applicable rules.
edits.name: production

edits.text: 3. RESERVATION. Defendant reserves the right to supplement, clarify, or amend these responses as discovery progresses and additional information becomes available.
edits.name: reservation
